title: WEAK SPOT ONCE PER TARGET
why: His order of 2026-10-09: the raid text reads like a shooter HUD, where a hit callout shows once, not once per pellet. A shotgun blast on a vent pushed one WEAK SPOT label per pellet, eight stacked words in one frame, and the flood of callouts pushed the names of what he had just looted out of the list of world labels. WEAK SPOT now shows at most once per target every half second, and when the list is full the oldest label that is not a loot name goes first. The damage, spark, clank and hit tick of every pellet are unchanged.
now: A shotgun blast on a weak spot now shows WEAK SPOT once instead of once per pellet, and loot names stay up during a fight.

edits.anchor: label(en.x,en.y-Math.round(en.r*1.3),'WEAK SPOT',WK.c,0,true);   /* v21.64, HIS NOTE (2026-10-09): OPTIC 2X read as a scope, not a weak point; it says WEAK SPOT, in the weak point colour */
edits.replacement:
/* v22.xx, the raid text rewrite (R46): WEAK SPOT ONCE PER TARGET. A shotgun blast or a fast burst on a vent pushed one
                     WEAK SPOT label per pellet, eight stacked words in one frame that also pushed the loot names out of the 40-label
                     list. The label now shows at most once per target every 0.5 s (en.weakLblT); the damage, the spark, the clank, the
                     hit tick and the count of weak hits stay per pellet. */
                  if(!(en.weakLblT>(G.t||0)-0.5)){ en.weakLblT=(G.t||0); label(en.x,en.y-Math.round(en.r*1.3),'WEAK SPOT',WK.c,0,true); }   /* v21.64, HIS NOTE (2026-10-09): OPTIC 2X read as a scope, not a weak point; it says WEAK SPOT, in the weak point colour */
